tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: bone-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, notices, inputs: anything that sits on bone.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Control borders (buttons, inputs): 3:1 on bone and bone-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bone and bone-raised (13:1 and up in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata and secondary text on bone and bone-raised (5.4:1 and up).

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: The brand colour: primary buttons, links, the mark. Link text on bone (5:1 light, 6.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-clay
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a clay fill (5.7:1 light, 6.2:1 dark); never plain white in dark.

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: Tag and notice fills in the clay tone.

tokens.name: clay-ink
tokens.usage: Text on clay-soft (5.7:1 light, 6.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: glaze
tokens.usage: Second hue: kiln status, in stock, calm confirmations. Text on bone and glaze-soft (5:1 and up).

tokens.name: glaze-soft
tokens.usage: Tag and notice fills in the glaze tone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid at a 2px offset. An alias of ink, so it follows the theme.

families.serif: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the page's subject.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags; between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding (inline).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and notice padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections; page gutter from 768px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, notices.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers only; cards use a rule border, not a shadow.
